sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO TACCOUNT_TAX_IF A USING ( SELECT #ACCNO# AS ACCNO, #ACCSEQ# AS ACCSEQ FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.ACCNO = B.ACCNO AND A.ACCSEQ = B.ACCSEQ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STATUS = #STATUS#, GL_DATE = #GL_DATE#, CURRENCY = #CURRENCY#, DEBIT = #DEBIT#, CREDIT = #CREDIT#, ACODE = #ACODE#, SAUPJ = #SAUPJ#, ACODENM = #ACODENM#, REMARK = #REMARK#, A01_REGNO = #A01_REGNO#, A01_CUSTOMERNM = #A01_CUSTOMERNM#, A01_CCODE = #A01_CCODE#, CT01_NAME = #CT01_NAME#, REFNO1 = #REFNO1#, REFNO2 = #REFNO2#, ISSUE_DATE = #ISSUE_DATE#, DUE_DATE = #DUE_DATE#, BANK = #BANK#, QUANTITY = #QUANTITY#, ITEM_UNIT = #ITEM_UNIT#, PRICE = #PRICE#, ITEM = #ITEM#, FINA_CLASS = #FINA_CLASS#, WHOUT_TYPE = #WHOUT_TYPE#, PRIN_AMOUNT = #PRIN_AMOUNT#, RATE = #RATE#, A01_REFNO5 = #A01_REFNO5#, A01_ATTRIBUTE2 = #A01_ATTRIBUTE2#, REFNO3 = #REFNO3#, REFNO4 = #REFNO4#, APPROVE_STATUS = #APPROVE_STATUS#, APPROVE_EMPLOYEE = #APPROVE_EMPLOYEE#, APPROVE_DATE = #APPROVE_DATE#, ENTRY_DATE = #ENTRY_DATE#, CREATE_DATE = #CREATE_DATE#, REFNO10 = #REFNO10#, EMPLOYEE = #EMPLOYEE#, A01_STATUS = #A01_STATUS#, A01_APPROVE_STATUS = #A01_APPROVE_STATUS#, IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ACCNO, ACCSEQ, STATUS, GL_DATE, CURRENCY, DEBIT, CREDIT, ACODE, SAUPJ, ACODENM, REMARK, A01_REGNO, A01_CUSTOMERNM, A01_CCODE, CT01_NAME, REFNO1, REFNO2, ISSUE_DATE, DUE_DATE, BANK, QUANTITY, ITEM_UNIT, PRICE, ITEM, FINA_CLASS, WHOUT_TYPE, PRIN_AMOUNT, RATE, A01_REFNO5, A01_ATTRIBUTE2, REFNO3, REFNO4, APPROVE_STATUS, APPROVE_EMPLOYEE, APPROVE_DATE, ENTRY_DATE, CREATE_DATE, REFNO10, EMPLOYEE, A01_STATUS, A01_APPROVE_STATUS, IF_DATE ) VALUES ( #ACCNO#, #ACCSEQ#, #STATUS#, #GL_DATE#, #CURRENCY#, #DEBIT#, #CREDIT#, #ACODE#, #SAUPJ#, #ACODENM#, #REMARK#, #A01_REGNO#, #A01_CUSTOMERNM#, #A01_CCODE#, #CT01_NAME#, #REFNO1#, #REFNO2#, #ISSUE_DATE#, #DUE_DATE#, #BANK#, #QUANTITY#, #ITEM_UNIT#, #PRICE#, #ITEM#, #FINA_CLASS#, #WHOUT_TYPE#, #PRIN_AMOUNT#, #RATE#, #A01_REFNO5#, #A01_ATTRIBUTE2#, #REFNO3#, #REFNO4#, #APPROVE_STATUS#, #APPROVE_EMPLOYEE#, #APPROVE_DATE#, #ENTRY_DATE#, #CREATE_DATE#, #REFNO10#, #EMPLOYEE#, #A01_STATUS#, #A01_APPROVE_STATUS#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') )
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM TACCOUNT_TAX_MAPPING WHERE GROUP_KEY IN ( SELECT GROUP_KEY FROM TACCOUNT_TAX_MAPPING WHERE (ACCNO, ACCSEQ) IN ( SELECT ACCNO, ACCSEQ FROM TACCOUNT_TAX_IF WHERE STATUS = 'D' ) )
